newsitem.title: USA: Koch Industries to set up LME base metals unit.
newsitem.headline: Koch Industries to set up LME base metals unit.

text.p: Diversified commodities and energy company Koch Industries Inc said it plans to set up a wholly owned subsidiary in Britain to trade base metals on the London Metal Exchange.
The unit, Koch Metals Trading Ltd, will apply to the LME to become an associate member. No date for the application or start-up of the business has been set.
Koch said the goal of the unit was to provide hedging services in base metals for producers, end-users, merchants and money managers.
Koch Industries is the second largest privately held company in the United States. It is involved in oil and gas, agriculture, chemicals, minerals, real estate and financial investments businesses.
